[INJSO 2013 — question paper]
66. The natural voices of men, women and children are different and can be distinguished.
A student makes three hypotheses
I. The amplitudes of sounds emitted by them are different.
II. The vocal cords are of different sizes.
III. The vocal cords vibrate with different frequencies.
The correct option is
A. I only.
B. II only.
C. III only.
D. I and III only.
